reviews.title: So good cooler
reviews.comment: The cooler works great, the temperatures are smooth and it's completely silent. The background customization is amazing; you can upload any video with the resolution of a mobile phone (in my case).1080x1920 and it looks super sharp and flawless. I have an overclocked Ryzen 5 7600 and the temperatures are very good; before, I was getting 70 degrees for almost everything. With this cooler, I'm playing Monster Hunter Wilds or demanding games 50 to 60 degrees
reviews.author: Sebastian
